question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word:**
solution: The correct answer is "Rebber." ***__Key Points__** __ • The incorrectly spelt word is **"Rebber."** • The correct spelling is** "Rubber."** • **"Rubber"** means a strong substance that can be stretched and does not allow water to pass through it, used for making tyres, boots, etc. Rubber is made from the juice of a tropical tree or is produced using chemicals. (रासायनिक प्रक्रिया द्वारा प्राप्त या उष्णकटिबंधीय वृक्ष से उत्पन्न द्रव से तैयार एक मज़बूत पदार्थ जिससे पहिये, जूते आदि तैयार किए जाते है; रबड़) • Example: This is a **rubber**__ band.* • The correct answer is Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Radar: **a system that uses radio waves for finding the position of moving objects, for example ships and planes. (रडार (चलते जहाज़, उड़ते विमान आदि की स्थिति का पता लगाने के लिए रेडियो तरंगों का उपयोग करने वाली उपकरण-प्रणाली)) • **Rather: **quite; to some extent. (काफ़ी; किसी हद तक) • **Robber: **a person who steals from a place or a person, especially using violence or threats. (लुटेरा, डाकू) 18a:Ta46, The correct answer is '**To take a short nap**'.
